svg.title: The First 30 Days Build Evidence, Not Assumed Royalty Income
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-evidence-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: The First 30 Days Build Evidence, Not Assumed Royalty Income; subtitle: Four weekly milestones prepare a disciplined licensing pipeline.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone ending days. Deliverables are 30-day operating targets, not executed-license forecasts. First-deal planning remains 4–14 months; the sprint does not change the canonical revenue or staffing scenarios.; caption: Finish the month with a rights dossier, tested use cases, a draft term structure, and a working reporting rehearsal.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Complete one asset dossier and rights-exception register; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Inventory ownership documents, licensed territories, asset identifiers, and existing grants. Assign every unresolved title or permission question to counsel.; label: Days 8-14; value: Screen twenty accounts and seek five buyer interviews; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Rank accounts by concrete use case and ability to report usage. Record actual interview outcomes; unanswered outreach does not count as validated demand.; label: Days 15-21; value: Draft one scoped offer and royalty calculation schedule; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Define minimum guarantees, royalty deductions, permitted uses, audit rights, and quality controls. Run the four pre-flight checks before circulating commercial commitments.; label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse reporting and establish the next development cycle; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Load synthetic royalty records into SQLite, reconcile one sample invoice, and test renewal reminders. Review buyer evidence and cash runway before further spending.

text.title: The First 30 Days Build Evidence, Not Assumed Royalty Income
text.tspan: The First 30 Days Build Evidence, Not Assumed Royalty

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Complete one asset dossier and rights-exception register; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Inventory ownership documents, licensed territories, asset identifiers, and existing grants. Assign every unresolved title or permission question to counsel.

text.title: Complete one asset dossier and rights-exception register

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Screen twenty accounts and seek five buyer interviews; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Rank accounts by concrete use case and ability to report usage. Record actual interview outcomes; unanswered outreach does not count as validated demand.

text.title: Screen twenty accounts and seek five buyer interviews

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Draft one scoped offer and royalty calculation schedule; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Define minimum guarantees, royalty deductions, permitted uses, audit rights, and quality controls. Run the four pre-flight checks before circulating commercial commitments.

text.title: Draft one scoped offer and royalty calculation schedule

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse reporting and establish the next development cycle; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Load synthetic royalty records into SQLite, reconcile one sample invoice, and test renewal reminders. Review buyer evidence and cash runway before further spending.

text.title: Rehearse reporting and establish the next development cycle

Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone ending days. Deliverables are 30-day operating targets, not executed-license forecasts. First-deal planning remains 4–14 months; the sprint does not change the canonical revenue or staffing scenarios.
